query_snapshot: Which alloy and heat-treatment conditions does NASA SP-8119 identify as susceptible to stress corrosion in its material-compatibility discussion?
final_answer:
Evidence-grounded answer:

- NASA SP-8119 states: "Materials susceptible to stress corrosion should not be used." [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- 2014-T4 is listed as a material susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- 2024-T3 is listed as a material susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- 2024-T4 is listed as a material susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- 2024-T351 is listed as a material susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- PH15-7Mo RH950 is listed as a material susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- PH15-7Mo TH1050 is listed as a material susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- 17-7PH (annealed) is listed as a material susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- 17-7PH H900 is listed as a material susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- AM350 SCT850 is listed as a material susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- AM355 SCT850 is listed as a material susceptible to stress corrosion. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
- 17-4PH appears in the same list in the document, but the OCR'd heat-treatment codes in the source are shown as "RH9SO, THIOSO" (ambiguous in the scanned text). [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 68fbe1ed]
